title: Search by destination
acceptance: Given sailings exist, when a guest searches by destination, then only sailings to that destination are returned with ship, port, date, nights and from-price.

title: Filter by max price
acceptance: When a guest sets a maximum price per guest, then no sailing above that from-price is shown.

title: Quote calculation
acceptance: Total = base fare x cabin multiplier x guests - promo discount + 12% tax on discounted fare + $135 port fee per guest, rounded to cents.

title: Percent promo applied once
acceptance: A valid percent promo (SAIL10) reduces the cruise fare by exactly that percent, applied once.

title: Flat promo minimum guests
acceptance: WAVE200 gives $200 off only when there are 2 or more guests; with 1 guest it is rejected with a clear message.

title: Invalid or expired promo rejected
acceptance: An unknown or expired promo code is rejected with a guest-readable message and no discount.

title: Sold-out cabins not bookable
acceptance: A cabin type with no availability cannot be quoted or booked and shows as sold out.

title: Successful booking
acceptance: With valid guest details and an approved card, a booking is CONFIRMED with a confirmation number and the charged total equals the quote.

title: Declined card
acceptance: A declined card shows a clear retry message and creates no booking.

title: Payment gateway outage
acceptance: If the payment gateway is unavailable the guest is told they have not been charged and no booking is created.

title: API contract
acceptance: Search, quote and booking responses conform to the published JSON schemas that web and mobile clients depend on.

title: GraphQL parity
acceptance: The GraphQL quote returns the same totals as the REST quote for the same inputs.

title: Accessible booking journey
acceptance: Search, cabin and checkout pages have no serious or critical WCAG violations reported by axe.

title: Mobile booking journey
acceptance: A guest can complete search to confirmation on a phone-sized viewport.
